description.to:
Outcome: One spend gate that every model call path goes through: the procedure runner and agents, editorial checks (Humanus), Cyclotron decisions and retrains, image generation (image-service), transcripts, AI moderation and submission extraction (reader-steering), web search. Before: Prospectus quota check for the tenant's Account (a cheap read; 402 quota_exhausted means do not start). Expensive batch work reserves its estimate and settles. After: record the actual items in a batch. A refusal shows the plain message "This site has used this week's budget; it resets <time>" and records nothing. Fail closed: if Prospectus cannot answer, model work does not start (serving pages never depends on this).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): src/papyrus_content/model_cost.py, new src/papyrus_content/spend_gate.py, the model-calling modules (procedure runner, editorial checks, cyclotron, web_search.py, image generation in amplify/functions/image-service, reader-steering moderation in amplify/plugins/reader-steering/function), lib/ twin for TypeScript functions.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/model-spend-ceiling.feature):
Scenario: A tenant over its weekly budget cannot start model work
    Given Prospectus answers quota_exhausted for alpha's Account
    When an editor asks for an editorial check
    Then no model is called and the editor sees when the budget resets

Scenario: Serving is not affected by the budget
    Given alpha's budget is exhausted
    When a reader opens alpha's home page
    Then it is served normally

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-3fd951. Blocks PPY-1f83a6. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-ea3f08.

Testing: Behave with a fake quota server; a CI grep that every model client is constructed through the gate.
Rollout: Shared stack first; dedicated customers billed by usage get it too.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a code path calls a model directly and spends unmetered. Mitigation: the model clients are only constructible through the gate (factory), and the CI grep fails on direct construction.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
